title: Portion weights: one piece or serving of a dish, from published household-measure data
rules: Each reference is a USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 (survey) or SR Legacy food portion: the food's FDC id plus the exact portion label; the grams are read from foods.db at build time.

This is a single-source set: no second independent table of Indian piece weights is available locally (INDB's Units.xlsx lists ingredient measures only; INDB serving weights are recipe yields divided by servings, see data/indb/README.md). Treat it as a check of gross portion errors, not as precise truth.

`hide` (or the set A dish's `hide`) is the pattern of catalog names hidden from the model. The phrase is logged as the app logs it: with the dish hidden from the catalog, the AI estimate's serving decides the grams for '1 <dish>'. The score is the logged grams against the reference.
